title: cutover-prep(ui-merge): the 9 `@object-ui/types` duration keys carry their unit in the key name, with ADR-0087 conversions, before the freeze (parent #25677, decision E)
body:
Filing gate ③ + ④: pre-freeze prep card of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`), decided by the maintainer as cutover decision **E** (director thread, 2026-10-25 09:06Z: 「17e · 同意」). Part of #25677. Lands in **objectstack-ai/objectui** `main` before the cutover freeze (#25752 step 2); the objectstack side needs no change.

**谁付代价(业务筛):** after the cutover, objectstack's spec gate `check:duration-unit-keys` runs over `ui/packages/types/src/zod` and refuses 9 keys whose description names a unit the key name lacks. Either every ui author keeps reading `timeout: 300` without knowing whether it is ms or s (the defect ADR-0087 retired on the objectstack side in #15679/#15680), or the gate is exempted for `ui/`, which keeps two vocabularies in one repo. The maintainer chose the rename.

## 维护者速读

objectui 的 `@object-ui/types` 里 9 个时长键(autoPlay、autoResponseDelay、timeout、delay、duration、delayDuration、openDelay、closeDelay、refreshInterval)只在描述里写单位,键名没有。合并后 objectstack 的 `check:duration-unit-keys` 会把它们判红。你裁定改名(E),本卡在冻结前于 objectui 完成:键名带单位、旧拼写按 ADR-0087 的方式退役(拒绝并给出修法)、附转换项与 `major` changeset。

## What to change (objectui, one draft PR to `main`)

1. The 9 keys, as the gate names them on the merged tree (verify run 8 head 3b0be7ca98, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:duration-unit-keys`): `autoPlay`, `autoResponseDelay`, `timeout`, `delay`, `duration`, `delayDuration`, `openDelay`, `closeDelay`, `refreshInterval` — all under `ui/packages/types/src/zod/**`. Re-measure on the merged layout first (recipe below); the list is a lead, the gate's output is the spec.
2. Each key is renamed so the name carries the unit its description states (the objectstack precedent is #15679/#15680: `…Ms` / `…Seconds` as the description says; read the description, do not assume ms).
3. The old spelling is retired the way ADR-0087 prescribes, adapted to objectui: an author who still writes the old key gets a refusal that names the new key (objectui's retired-key / guidance mechanism if it has one — measure: `grep -rn "retiredKey\|UNKNOWN_KEY_GUIDANCE\|spec-changes" ui/packages/types ui/scripts` — otherwise a `.strict()` refusal with the guidance in the error text), plus a conversion entry where objectui keeps a conversion registry, plus a `major` changeset carrying the FROM → TO mapping for every key.
4. Every reader of the 9 keys inside objectui (renderers, plugins, tests, docs snippets, examples, QUICK_REFERENCE rows) follows the rename in the same PR; `pnpm type-check`, the affected `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols` and the docs/snippet gates stay green.

## Acceptance

- On the merged layout (verify branch `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r-25697-verify` head 9e37acd126 + your diff applied with `git apply --directory=ui`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:duration-unit-keys` reports **0** `ui/` findings and the objectstack-side findings are unchanged.
- objectui standalone: `pnpm type-check`, affected `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, docs gates green; CI green on the draft PR.
- The PR body lists the 9 FROM → TO pairs, the retirement mechanism used, and the changeset.

**Size:** M. **Clause-②:** yes (new authorable keys enter `@object-ui/types`'s published zod; old ones are refused with guidance). **Metadata-protocol:** added (new unit-bearing keys) + the old spellings refused. **Responsibility:** n/a — not a defect card.

## 风险

- Consumers outside objectui (customer apps on `@object-ui/types`) see a `major` for 9 renames; the conversion + guidance is the mitigation, and 18.x is the version line that already carries the merge.
- If objectui has no conversion registry, the card's deliverable for "conversions" is the `major` changeset + the refusal guidance; say so in the PR body rather than inventing a registry.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-25 09:12Z 「duration-unit-keys ui zod rename」: 7 hits, all closed objectstack-side ADR-0087 remediations (#15679, #15680, #17780–#17785, #18075); none covers `@object-ui/types`. **New.**
